arxiv-2103-09699.title: ShipSRDet: An End-to-End Remote Sensing Ship Detector Using Super-Resolved Feature Representation
arxiv-2103-09699.creator: Shitian He, Huanxin Zou*, Yingqian Wang, Runlin Li, Fei Cheng
arxiv-2103-09699.description: Abstract High-resolution remote sensing images can provide abundant appearance information for ship detection. Although several existing methods use image super-resolution (SR) approaches to improve the detection performance, they consider image SR and ship detection as two separate processes and overlook the internal coherence between these two correlated tasks.

arxiv-2109-13621.title: Physical Unclonable Functions using speckle patterns of perfect optical vortices
arxiv-2109-13621.creator: Patnala Vanitha, 1,∗ Bhargavi Manupati, 1, Inbarasan Muniraj, 1 Satish Anamalamudi, 1 Salla Gangi Reddy, 1,∗∗ and R. P. Singh 2
arxiv-2109-13621.description: Abstract Encryption techniques demonstrate a great deal of security when implemented in an optical system (such as holography) due to the inherent physical properties of light and the precision it demands. However, such systems have shown to be vulnerable during digital implementations under various crypt-analysis attacks.

arxiv-2206-11982.title: Infrared Phases of 3D Class R Theories
arxiv-2206-11982.creator: Sunjin Choi, Dongmin Gang, Hee-Cheol Kim
arxiv-2206-11982.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sunjin Choi, Dongmin Gang, Hee-Cheol Kim. We study the IR phases of 3D class R theories associated with closed non-hyperbolic 3-manifolds. Non-hyperbolic 3-manifolds can be obtained by performing Dehn fillings on 1-cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds along exceptional slopes. In 3D-3D correspondence, the ‘exceptional’ Dehn filling corresponds to the gauging of an S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) flavor symmetry in a superconformal field theory associated with a 1-cusped 3-manifold with ‘small’ Chern-Simons levels.

arxiv-2207-00581.title: On Leave-One-Out Conditional Mutual Information For Generalization
arxiv-2207-00581.creator: Mohamad Rida Rammal, Alessandro Achille, Aditya Golatkar, Suhas Diggavi, Stefano Soatto
arxiv-2207-00581.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mohamad Rida Rammal, Alessandro Achille, Aditya Golatkar, Suhas Diggavi, Stefano Soatto. We derive information theoretic generalization bounds for supervised learning algorithms based on a new measure of leave-one-out conditional mutual information (loo-CMI). Contrary to other CMI bounds, which are black-box bounds that do not exploit the structure of the problem and may be hard to evaluate in practice, our loo-CMI bounds can be computed easily and can be interpreted in connection to other notions such as classical leave-one-out cross-validation, stability of the optimization algorithm,

arxiv-2301-12004.title: Understanding the Effectiveness of Very Large Language Models on Dialog Evaluation
arxiv-2301-12004.creator: Jessica Huynh, Cathy Jiao, Prakhar Gupta, Shikib Mehri, Payal Bajaj, Vishrav Chaudhary, Maxine Eskenazi
arxiv-2301-12004.description: Abstract Language models have steadily increased in size over the past few years. They achieve a high level of performance on various natural language processing (NLP) tasks such as question answering and summarization. Large language models (LLMs) have been used for generation and can now output human-like text.

arxiv-2309-16989.title: Extensions realizing affine datum : low-dimensional cohomology
arxiv-2309-16989.creator: Alexander Wires
arxiv-2309-16989.description: Abstract . For arbitrary varieties of universal algebras, we develop the theory around the first and second-cohomology groups characterizing extensions realizing affine datum. Restricted to varieties with a weak-difference term, extensions realizing affine datum are exactly extensions with abelian kernels.

arxiv-2404-07578.title: Hyperpolarisation Dynamics: Asymptotic Polarisation
arxiv-2404-07578.creator: O.T. Whaites, T.S. Monteiro
arxiv-2404-07578.description: Abstract For applications of solid state quantum computing and quantum simulations, high fidelity initialisation of thermally mixed electronic and nuclear spin qubits is essential. Whereas electronic spins can readily be initialised optically to high fidelity, initialisation of the nuclear spins requires alternative approaches, such as dynamic nuclear polarisation (DNP) via the electronic spin.

arxiv-2406-00973.title: Cold-start Recommendation by Personalized Embedding Region Elicitation
arxiv-2406-00973.creator: Hieu Trung Nguyen, Duy Nguyen, Khoa Doan, Viet Anh Nguyen
arxiv-2406-00973.description: Abstract Rating elicitation is a success element for recommender systems to perform well at cold-starting, in which the systems need to recommend items to a newly arrived user with no prior knowledge about the user’s preference. Existing elicitation methods employ a fixed set of items to learn the user’s preference and then infer the users’ preferences on the remaining items.

arxiv-2412-13453.title: Modeling extremal dependence in multivariate and spatial problems: a practical perspective
arxiv-2412-13453.creator: Boris Béranger, Simone A. Padoan
arxiv-2412-13453.description: Abstract From environmental sciences to finance, there is a growing demand for methods that can assess the risks of extreme events beyond those observed in available data. Extrapolating extreme events beyond the range of the data is not obvious. Risk assessments are often further complicated by the need to account for multiple variables simultaneously.

In 114 depressed inpatients suffering from unipolar or bipolar depression (sample 1) the DEX/CRH test was performed at admission and shortl

pmc-11385154.title: A patient-derived cell model for malignant transformation in IDH-mutant glioma
pmc-11385154.creator: Olga Kim, Zach Sergi, Guangyang Yu, Kazutoshi Yamamoto, Martha Quezado, Zied Abdullaev, Danel R Crooks, Shun Kishimoto, Qi Li, Peng Lu, Burchelle Blackman, Thorkell Andresson, Xiaolin Wu, Bao Tran, Jun S Wei, Wei Zhang, Meili Zhang, Hua Song, Javed Khan, Murali C Krishna, Jeffrey R Brender, Jing Wu
pmc-11385154.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Malignant transformation (MT) is commonly seen in IDH-mutant gliomas. There has been a growing research interest in revealing its underlying mechanisms and intervening prior to MT at the early stages of the transforming process.

pmc-12582406.title: Variation in echolocation call emission of Neotropical insect-eating bats in response to shifting ambient temperatures
pmc-12582406.creator: Paula M Iturralde-Pólit, Marcelo Araya-Salas, Holger R Goerlitz, Gloriana Chaverri
pmc-12582406.description: The sensory systems of animals are essential for them to respond to environmental cues and signals. However, their functionality might be altered by climate change. Most bats, for example, rely on acoustic signal emission to acquire food, but their high-frequency echolocation calls are strongly attenuated in the air.

pmc-12599165.title: Molecular features influencing clinical outcome of advanced HER2-positive gastric cancer receiving trastuzumab plus chemotherapy
pmc-12599165.creator: Yu Lei, Danxi He, Jiqing Si, Junrong Yan, Minchi Yuan
pmc-12599165.description: BackgroundLess than half of the human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-positive gastric cancer (GC) patients respond to trastuzumab plus chemotherapy, and the outcomes are unsatisfactory. Understanding the underlying mechanisms remains crucial for identifying patients who are more likely to benefit from treatment.

pmc-12624083.title: Bipolar electrochemical tweezers using pristine carbon fibers with intrinsically asymmetric features
pmc-12624083.creator: Bhavana Gupta, Vishal Shrivastav, Shashank Sundriyal, Ambrose Ashwin Melvin, Marcin Holdynski, Alexander Kuhn, Wojciech Nogala
pmc-12624083.description: Structures that can be stimulated to change shape may be utilized for a variety of applications, but they frequently need to be processed and modified. We propose here a simple, straightforward strategy of actuation based on bipolar electrochemistry driving asymmetric reactions at the surface grooves of pristine carbon fibers.

pmc-13040693.title: Life-course influence of birthweight and subsequent pathways on healthy aging: a Mendelian randomization study
pmc-13040693.creator: Lijie Kong, Chun Dou, Chaojie Ye, Dong Liu, Mingling Chen, Jie Zheng, Min Xu, Yu Xu, Mian Li, Zhiyun Zhao, Jieli Lu, Yuhong Chen, Guang Ning, Weiqing Wang, Yufang Bi, Ruixin Liu, Tiange Wang
pmc-13040693.description: BackgroundBirthweight readily measurable marker of fetal growth that may influence health across the lifespan. We aimed to investigate the potential causal association between birthweight and healthy aging and to identify the mediating roles of subsequent socioeconomic, behavioral, functional, and disease-related factors to inform life-course strategies to promote healthy aging and reduce health inequities.

pmc-13268037.title: 6. Words That Match: Linguistic Analysis of Plastic Surgery Residency Personal Statements to Predict Match and Identify Bias
pmc-13268037.creator: Malka Korenblit, David Le, Celia Ernstrom, Skyler Palmer, Mark Greyson, David W. Mathes, David Khechoyan, Jason Yu, Katie Egan
pmc-13268037.description: nd subjective assessments such as the personal statement. Prior analyses across other specialties suggest that linguistic features—reflecting tone, reasoning, and self-presentation—may influence applicant success and reveal systemic bias. Whether similar linguistic patterns exist in plastic surgery remains unknown. Methods: Retrospective analysis of 298 integrated plastic surgery applicants (24-25 cycle) to one institution was performed.

pmc-13393784.title: Construction of pre-vascularized bone-like tissue by incorporation of mesodermal progenitor cells through simulating endochondral ossification
pmc-13393784.creator: Yian Guan, Zixin Wang, Hui Wang, Rong Huang, Jing Lin, Yuan Wang, Dongyang Ma, Ping Zhou, Liling Ren
pmc-13393784.description: BackgroundPre-vascularized cartilage enhances bone regeneration (intrachondral osteogenesis) and accelerates bone defect healing. While current strategies focus on co-culturing chondrocytes with endothelial cells, mature endothelial cells inhibit the necessary osteogenic transformation. To overcome this, we implemented a co-differentiation strategy using human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs)-derived mesodermal progenitor cells (iMPCs) instead.

pmc-13545626.creator: Yingze Ning, Shuai Tian, Guangliang Qiang

pmc-13588711.title: Resource use and associated energy expenditure of African crowned eagles (Stephanoaetus coronatus) in an urban-forest mosaic landscape
pmc-13588711.creator: Lara Howard, Varalika Jain, Shane C Sumasgutner, Jesús Bautista, Ralph Buij, Colleen T Downs, Susan J Cunningham, Petra Sumasgutner
pmc-13588711.description: Rapid urbanization is a major driver of global change, making it increasingly important to understand how wildlife persists in highly transformed landscapes. Using insights from movement (Global Positioning System, GPS) and activity (accelerometry, ACC) data, we aimed to understand the behavioral and physiological mechanisms associated with an apex predator's successful exploitation of heavily transformed landscapes.

pmc-13684602.title: Combined Image-Based Profiling and Biochemical Analysis of GCaMP Overexpression Effects on Mammalian Cells
pmc-13684602.creator: Laura Beebe, Lin Tian, Loren L. Looger
pmc-13684602.description: Protein-based fluorescent sensors are a powerful addition to a biologist’s toolbox for their ability to be stably expressed within living organisms, tissues, cells, and subcellular compartments, with the capacity to report on the presence of specific target molecules or other analytes.
